validity.segment_name: Stage III: Lipin Bor-Vytegra Gas Pipeline
validity.recommendation: No change to existence, classification, or duplicate status. P4078 is a real, well-documented segment (Stage III, Lipin Bor-Vytegra) of Gazprom's Sheksna-Kirillov-Lipin Bor-Vytegra-Pudozh multi-stage gasification project in Vologda Oblast, realized under a cooperation agreement between the regional government and PJSC Gazprom (signed by Governor Kuvshinnikov and Gazprom CEO Alexey Miller). It is independently corroborated across a 2016-2026 span of sources (newsvo.ru 2016 whole-project origin; sudact.ru 2015 federal planning schedule item 31; vologda.mk.ru 2020; okuvshinnikov.ru 2022 groundbreaking; vo.rbc.ru 2024; vytegra.news 2025 completion; neftegaz.ru PMEF-2026 program-completion report). Classification (Fuel=Gas, PipelineType=transmission) is directly supported by the federal trunk-gas-pipeline planning schedule. No duplicate risk: this row is clearly distinct from its siblings P4076 (Stage I: Sheksna-Kirillov) and P4077 (Stage II: Kirillov-Lipin Bor) -- each stage has its own distinct route, own groundbreaking date, and (per okuvshinnikov.ru) its own explicitly stated length figure. An unlisted 'Stage IV' (Vytegra-Pudozh, into the Republic of Karelia) also exists per gem.wiki and multiple sources (vologdazso.ru/rbc 09-Apr-2024 reports Stage IV equipment mobilization) but is NOT part of this 28-row batch roster and is out of scope for this pass -- noted only to avoid a future false-duplicate flag if Stage IV is ever added as its own PID. CAVEAT: see the separate 'spec' concern below regarding SegmentCost, which IS a genuine data defect on this row (and on sibling rows P4076/P4077).
validity.researcher_notes: Read to exhaustion across 10+ independently-sourced Russian-language articles/documents spanning 2016-2026 (see fills[] for the full per-unit source list); cross-checked against gem.wiki's own project page for structural orientation only (read-only, never cited per standing rule 1). No existence, classification, or duplicate-identity problem found for P4078 itself.

This EXACT same aggregate value and EXACT same source URL (vologda.mk.ru) is ALSO staged identically on sibling rows P4076 (Stage I) and P4077 (Stage II) per the worklist -- i.e. the same project-wide total is being recorded THREE separate times as if it were three different segments' own costs, which overstates the combined recorded cost of the project roughly 3x if all three rows' SegmentCost values were ever summed. Recommend: clear SegmentCost/SegmentCostUnits/SegmentCostYear on P4078 (and flag P4076/P4077 the same way, see cross_row_leads[]) pending discovery of an actual per-stage cost breakdown, OR at minimum add a ResearcherNotes caveat on all three rows stating the figure is project-wide, not segment-specific. No segment-specific cost breakdown was found despite a dedicated search pass.
